races.name: Jaspey
races.creator_god: Hathruna - Goddess of seasonal rebirth, decay, fungi, roots, and living wilderness.
races.category_pantheon_influence: Peoples in this group inherit social expectations, supernatural instincts, ritual customs, and cultural myths shaped by Hathruna.
races.description: Ability Score Increase.
races.lore: Tiny fungal raccoon-folk born from ancient symbiotic spores and scavenger spirits, Jaspey are eerie yet lovable creatures that blur the line between woodland fae, living fungus, and grave-born scavenger. Though their appearance often resembles tiny undead raccoons stitched together with moss, mushrooms, and decay, Jaspey are fully living beings with beating hearts, warm emotions, and vibrant cultures. Standing only a few inches tall, Jaspey can sleep inside coat pockets, teacups, backpacks, hollow books, hat brims, or even small tins. Entire hidden settlements may exist unnoticed inside old walls, cemetery gardens, forgotten cupboards, abandoned wagons, or the roots of ancient trees. Jaspey are natural scavengers, herbalists, healers, thieves, potion brewers, and strange little mystics. They collect shiny objects obsessively, form strong emotional bonds with larger companions, and often travel alongside adventuring parties as medics, alchemists, scouts, or magical nuisances.
races.pantheon_influence: Creator God: Hathruna. Hathruna is the primary creator of the Jaspey, blooming tiny fungal raccoon-folk from rot, spores, roots, scavenger spirits, and the cycle of decay into renewal. Jaspey theology teaches that nothing useful is truly trash: what the powerful discard becomes food, medicine, shelter, story, and sometimes rebellion. Secondary Divine Pressures. Ishtanora is a beloved hearth-patron to Jaspey villages because fungal gardens turn decay into comfort, medicine, and communal survival. Nefarokir is respected in grave-gardens where bones, memory, and compost are carefully separated so the dead are not stolen from their proper passage. Thoryn-Rahek is feared in uncontrolled spore blooms, violent mutations, and fungal hungers that no colony can name. Marduthor is honored by scavenger-crafters who turn broken locks, bottlecaps, wire, and discarded tools into practical magic. Rites, Taboos, and Ichor Marks. The First Find is a rite where a young Jaspey brings home something abandoned and explains how it can serve the colony. The Soft Burial places beloved dead in protected fungal beds, not to erase them, but to let their last gifts become medicine or shelter. Wasting salvage, poisoning a communal spore-bed, or hoarding medicine during sickness are severe taboos. Ichor-touched Jaspey may grow black-edged mushrooms, dream through nearby fungus, or produce spores that briefly reveal hidden decay, lies, or sickness. DM Hooks. Use Jaspey pantheon influence for undercity colonies, fungal healers, sacred scavenger routes, rot-cults, grave-garden disputes, or tiny heroes who know exactly which forgotten scrap can save a doomed settlement.

belavados_table_abilities: Ability Score Increase.
Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom or Intelligence score increases by 1.
Age.

Jaspey mature rapidly, reaching adulthood around 4 years old. Most live between 25 and 40 years, though ancient fungal sages and colony elders sometimes survive for over a century under ideal conditions.
Alignment.
Jaspey tend toward chaotic or neutral alignments. They value adaptability, freedom, comfort, curiosity, and survival more than laws or rigid traditions.
Most Jaspey are not malicious, though some become selfish scavengers, manipulative tricksters, grave robbers, or unsettling fungal occultists.
Creature Type.
You are a Humanoid.
You are also considered a Plant for any prerequisite, spell, magical effect, or item that specifically affects plant creatures.
Size.
You are Tiny.

races.pantheon_influence: Oskar'enlil shapes this lineage through experimental races balancing adaptation, civilization, and instinct.
races.axis_reading_text: Altruism: 1500 (Balanced empathy); Lawfulness: 1500 (Balanced order/freedom); Cooperation: 1500 (Adaptive); Honor: 1500 (Morally flexible).
races.canon_index_trait_names: +2 Constitution, +1 One Other Ability Score, Darkvision, Animal Enhancement (Guildmasters’ Guide to Ravnica).
